title: At the Park
text:
Ana is in the park. It is sunny today. She has a red ball. She plays with her ball.

Her friend Luis comes to the park. He has a blue bike. Ana smiles. They play together.

questions.text: How does Ana feel when Luis comes?
Why does Ana probably like the park?
options: Because she plays there with a friend

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people can play and relax
a round object that people throw, kick or hit in games
a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal

paragraph_translations: Ana está en el parque. Hoy hace sol. Ella tiene una pelota roja. Ella juega con su pelota.
Su amigo Luis llega al parque. Él tiene una bicicleta azul. Ana sonríe. Ellos juegan juntos.
